article:
For each question, choose the correct answer.
Honey
People all over the world enjoy eating honey. But how much do you know about this (21) .................. food? Honey is made by bees, but what few people realise is that there are several types of bee which make honey.
Bees may have to visit about two million flowers to produce only half a kilo of honey. The type of flower the bees visit (22) .................. the honey tastes and its colour. In fact, there are (23) .................. more than three hundred kinds of honey. In (24) .................. times, honey was added to food instead of sugar, as sugar was very rare. In many cultures, people have used it for centuries to (25) .................. various health problems. (26) .................. people all over the world still add it to hot water and drink it when they have a sore throat.

questions.explanation:
“common” 表示 “常见的；普遍的”，修饰 “food” 指蜂蜜是一种常见食物。
A. usual（通常的）侧重 “习惯性的”；B. shared（共享的）与语境无关；C. general（一般的）强调 “总体上的”，
拓展：“common”、“ordinary”、“usual” 辨析：common：常见的（如 common problem）；ordinary：普通的（无特殊之处）；usual：惯常的（符合日常习惯）。

“affect” 意为 “影响”，指花的种类影响蜂蜜的味道和颜色。A. makes（使）需接 “宾语 + 宾补”，如 make honey taste sweet；C. guides（引导）、D. directs（指导）与 “味道” 搭配不当。
拓展：“affect”（动词）与 “effect”（名词）易混淆：The climate affects plant growth.（影响）The new policy has had a positive effect.（效果）

“actually” 表示 “实际上；事实上”，强调 “超过三百种蜂蜜” 的实际情况。
A. correctly（正确地）、C. accurately（精确地）侧重 “准确性”；D. absolutely（绝对地）语气过于强烈，不符合客观陈述。
拓展：“actually” 在口语中常用，用于纠正误解或强调事实，如：I thought he was French, but actually he’s Italian.

“ancient times” 为固定搭配，意为 “古代”。A. antique（古董的）修饰物品，如 antique furniture；B. far（远的）、C. elderly（年长的）与 “时代” 不搭配。
拓展：表示 “时代” 的词汇：ancient times（古代）；modern times（现代）；medieval times（中世纪）。

“cure” 意为 “治愈；治疗”，后接疾病或健康问题。B. mend/ C. repair（修理）用于物品，如 repair a bike；
D. assist（协助）需接 with，如 assist with a problem。
拓展：“cure” 与 “treat” 区别：cure：治愈（强调结果）；treat：治疗（强调过程）

“nowadays” 表示 “如今；现在”，与前文 “centuries” 形成时间对比。A. Recently/Lately（最近）侧重 “近期”，不与 “still” 搭配；D. Already（已经）常用于完成时，如 They have already left.
拓展：时间副词辨析：nowadays：现在（与过去对比）；currently：目前（强调当前阶段）；lately/recently：最近（时间较近）。
